info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Devices-v4-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Devices Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of devices associated with their streaming subscriptions. This endpoint empowers developers to integrate with the streaming service and manage device access efficiently. Typical consumers include application developers and partners seeking to enhance user experiences by tracking device usage and subscription management. By leveraging this API, applications can better inform users about their connected devices and optimize their streaming experiences.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of devices under subscriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the devices associated with the current subscriptions. It returns detailed information about each device, including their status and metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of devices associated with subscriptions. It should contain any necessary filters or parameters to specify the subscription details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of devices.
